name: field
useFor: Use Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription and FieldError around any control; FieldGroup to stack fields; FieldSet and FieldLegend for a titled group; orientation horizontal for a checkbox, radio or switch beside its label; FieldLabel around a Field for choice cards; FieldSeparator for or between two ways in.
constraints: A red label on an invalid field (only the line and the message turn brick)
source: Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107): the label, the field and the helper under the Range
title: Field
description: Mireye's form layout: a 12px label in 80% Forest 8px above the control, fields 16px apart, a 12px description in 72% Forest or a 12px brick error below. Legends are 16px Forest. A label that wraps a whole field is a choice card in the cut frame, Forest-lined on Fog when chosen.
